$$
The definition of $\operatorname{coth}⁡x$ is 

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{coth}⁡x & =\frac{1}{\operatorname{tanh}⁡x} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{x}+{e}^{-x}}{{e}^{x}-{e}^{-x}} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{2x}+1}{{e}^{2x}-1} \\  & =\frac{1+{e}^{-2x}}{1-{e}^{-2x}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the fourth definition, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{coth}⁡(-\operatorname{ln}⁡\frac{1}{2}) & =\frac{1+{e}^{-2(-\operatorname{ln}⁡\frac{1}{2})}}{1-{e}^{-2(-\operatorname{ln}⁡\frac{1}{2})}} \\  & =\frac{1+{e}^{2\operatorname{ln}⁡\frac{1}{2}}}{1-{e}^{2\operatorname{ln}⁡\frac{1}{2}}} \\  & =\frac{1+{e}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡{(\frac{1}{2})}^{2}}}{1-{e}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡{(\frac{1}{2})}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{(1+\frac{1}{4})}{(1-\frac{1}{4})} \\  & =\frac{5}{4}÷\frac{3}{4} \\  & =\frac{5}{4}\cdot \frac{4}{3} \\  & =\frac{5}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
